evals.name: hero-stagger
evals.prompt: Add staggered fade-in for storefront hero product cards using motion/react. Keep animations on transform and opacity only.
evals.expected_output: Uses motion/react imports, motion.div with variants/stagger, no width/height animation.
assertions: Animates x/y/scale/opacity rather than width height margin
Uses reduced-motion or respects prefers-reduced-motion when mentioned
Does not wrap admin DataTable or form fields unnecessarily

evals.name: reject-layout-animation
evals.prompt: Animate sidebar open by transitioning width from 0 to 280px with Framer Motion.
evals.expected_output: Rejects width animation; suggests x transform or CSS instead.
assertions: Does not recommend animating width for performance
Suggests transform translateX or existing shadcn Sheet pattern
